lint.details: No lint command configured in services.yaml or package.json. Skipped — not a failure.

nonBlockingIssues.description: buildLastWorkerResult always produces concrete arrays for decisions/warnings/commands_run/files_to_review (via ?? []), but LastWorkerResultSchema declares these fields as optional. Minor type-level asymmetry — consumers see possibly-undefined but values are always present.

VAL-HANDOFF-008 resilience tests replicate the execution-loop's undefined-handoff pattern rather than testing the actual error handling code path (try/catch around readHandoff). Acceptable given existing test coverage in reader.test.ts.
resetStageContext() method and standalone function are both dead code — never called in production. Reset-between-stages works because each new ExecutionLoop starts with empty context.
stage-context.json file is never cleaned up between pipeline stages. Safe currently since resume defaults to false, but could cause issues if resume support is enabled later.
SkillFeedbackEntrySchema in stage-context.ts re-defines the deviation shape inline instead of importing SkillDeviationSchema from handoff.ts. Shapes match currently but could drift.
ensureLibraryDir() helper in paths.ts is dead code in production — execution-loop.ts inlines the mkdirSync call directly. Only exercised by tests.
Shared Knowledge Library section in prompt is placed near the bottom of a long prompt, which may reduce worker compliance. Consider moving it earlier.
Manual field mapping in execution-loop.ts for skill_feedback could use direct object passthrough since SkillFeedback and SkillFeedbackData are structurally identical.
Type duplication: SkillFeedback (handoff.ts) and SkillFeedbackData (stage-context.ts) are identical types that could be unified.
BoundariesConfig interface in phase-prompt.ts manually duplicates the Zod schema shape from loader.ts. Should use z.infer<> for type safety.
Boundaries cast via 'as BoundariesConfig | undefined' is safe due to upstream Zod validation, but could mask issues if boundaries are injected outside the config path.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add stage-context.ts to the 'Pipeline and execution' table in the Architecture quick reference section. Entry: 'Stage context accumulator | src/controller/stage-context.ts'
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature cumulative-stage-context introduced src/controller/stage-context.ts as a new core pipeline component. Project AGENTS.md's architecture tables don't reference it. Multiple reviewers noted this gap.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a convention note recommending z.infer<typeof Schema> over manual interface duplication for Zod-derived types. Example: 'When defining TypeScript types that mirror Zod schemas, prefer z.infer<typeof MySchema> over manual interface definitions to prevent schema/type drift.'
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature explicit-boundaries introduced a manual BoundariesConfig interface that duplicates FlywheelConfigSchema.boundaries. This pattern creates maintenance risk as schemas evolve.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify in the backend-worker skill that the TDD red phase may manifest as compile/import errors (not just failing test assertions) when new exports are being introduced. This is expected — the red phase confirms the code doesn't work yet, whether via assertion failure or module-level error.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Worker on handoff-content-quality reported via skillFeedback that importing countSentences before it existed caused a module-level error rather than individual test failures. The skill's red phase wording implies individual assertion failures.
